statement: Given a trihedral angle \(Sxyz\). A plane \((P)\) not through \(S\) cuts \(Sx, Sy, Sz\) at \(A, B, C\). Outside triangle \(ABC\) on plane \((P)\), construct triangles \(DAB, EBC, FCA\) congruent to \(\triangle SAB, \triangle SBC, \triangle SCA\). Let \((T)\) be the sphere inside \(Sxyz\) but not inside tetrahedron \(SABC\), tangent to the faces containing \(SABC\). Prove that \((T)\) touches plane \((P)\) at the circumcenter of \(\triangle DEF\).

Given integers \(k, n\) with \(1 \leq k \leq n\). Find the number of ordered \(k\)-tuples \((a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_k)\) where \(a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_k\) are distinct elements of \(\{1, 2, \ldots, n\}\) satisfying:\\
1) There exist \(s, t\) with \(1 \leq s < t \leq k\) and \(a_s > a_t\).\\
2) There exists \(s\) with \(1 \leq s \leq k\) such that \(a_s \not\equiv s \pmod{2}\).

Find all \(f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}\) such that
\[f(n) + f(n+1) = f(n+2)f(n+3) - 1996\]
for all \(n \in \mathbb{N}\).

Triangle \(ABC\) has \(BC = 1\) and \(\angle BAC = a\). Find the shortest distance \(f(a)\) between the incenter and centroid. When \(a\) varies over \(\left(\dfrac{\pi}{3}, \pi\right)\), find the maximum value of \(f(a)\).
Prove that \(a + b + c + d \geq \dfrac{2}{3}(ab + bc + ca + ad + ac + bd)\) where \(a, b, c, d\) are positive reals satisfying \(2(ab + bc + cd + da + ac + bd) + abc + bcd + cda + dab = 16\).
